description: Adds many participants to a DRAFT signature request in one call. Requires: signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId, and a `participants` array; each entry takes the `id` you mint, `role` (SIGNATORY, OBSERVER or VALIDATOR), firstName, lastName, email and a phone (phonePrefix with the +, phoneNumber), REQUIRED for every SIGNATORY of an ADVANCED request. The platform links every valid signatory and observer to all documents itself, so there is no groupId or linkToAllDocuments; in a CONFIGURABLE request all signatories go to round 1 (use signature_participant_create with groupId for later rounds), and validators are linked afterwards with assign_validator_to_signatory. A bad entry (for example an ADVANCED signatory without a phone) is NOT refused: the call still returns 201 with no body and stores it invalid and unlinked, which blocks activation, so re-read with signature_participant_list and remove invalid ones with signature_participant_invalid_purge. A SIGNATORY with a phone in an INTERPOSITION or WITH_CERTIFICATE request is ALSO invited by WhatsApp (and by SMS where the platform enables it): leave the phone out to invite by email only. One VALIDATOR on a plan without validators rejects the whole call (409 SignatureValidatorsNotAllowed).
name: signature_participant_add_bulk
